annotation.title_clean: Guidelines on Assessment of AI Reliability in the Field of Plant Safety
annotation.title_en: Guidelines on Assessment of AI Reliability in the Field of Plant Safety
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Liaison Council of Three Ministries on Disaster Prevention of Petroleum Complexes (METI; Fire and Disaster Management Agency; MHLW)
annotation.venue: METI / Fire and Disaster Management Agency
annotation.summary_en: Japanese three-ministry guideline for assessing reliability of machine-learning components in petroleum and chemical plant safety. It adopts AIST's three-tier quality framework (quality in use, external, internal), sets risk-avoidance and performance levels, gives five use cases and role-based workflows, and relies on IEC 61508/61511 functional safety.
key_provisions_or_claims: Hierarchical reliability assessment: quality in use, external quality, internal quality for ML components.
Risk avoidance levels (0, 0.1, 0.2, 1) and performance levels (0-2) determine internal quality requirement levels.
ML components cannot be assigned SIL 2 or higher; external safety mechanisms can lower required level.
Five plant-safety use cases with worked examples and a 14-step lifecycle flow by role.
Does not relax laws; excludes hardware, cybersecurity, legal/ethical issues; owner responsible for explaining to regulators.
